$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers, committed to git. codebase-memory-mcp: installed via 'npm i -g codebase-memory-mcp'. On Windows the npm Node.js shim is incompatible with MCP stdio (uses spawnSync, not exec), so we point directly at the native binary. The npm global path is stable across Windows machines when installed via npm. macOS/Linux users: replace command with 'codebase-memory-mcp' (from PATH) or adjust to your install path. Override machine-specific paths in .mcp.local.json (gitignored).
